title: (No AI) Sure seems like Fenix Flexin used AI music generator Treblo
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![The seemingly AI generated cover art for Fenix Flexin’s Rubberz.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/artworks-WsdIgVXV8NOV-0-t1080x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

And you thought we were done with this one… | Image: Fenix Flexin

We were pretty sure that [Fenix Flexin's "Rubberz"](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/974209/fenix-flexin-billboard-hot-100-rubberz-ai-slop) was made using AI, but musician [Medasin](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dbbf1vCBuGO/) was confident that it was made using Treblo specifically. Now the company and a new [detection tool](https://treblo.com/detect) seem to confirm it.

On Monday, the company announced the open-source [Treblo AI Music Classifier](https://treblo.com/blog/treblo-ai-music-classifier), which detects when a song was generated using Treblo, though not other AI tools. According to a blog post, it has a false positive rate of less than 1 in 1,000. That's not unimpeachable, but it's notable that the company's own Classifier determined that "Rubberz" was "very likely Treblo" with "high confidence," adding more fuel to the PR nightmare for Fenix.

[…](https://soundcloud.com/fenixflexin/rubberz)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/975528/fenix-flexin-ai-music-generator-treblo)

title: (No AI) Google just announced a major shakeup of its top AI leadership
author: Jay Peters
content:
![An image of Demis Hassabis](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/gettyimages-2273112113.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google is making some significant AI leadership changes, including a major shift for Google DeepMind leader Demis Hassabis.

Hassabis will become the chair of Google DeepMind and the chief scientist at Alphabet, CEO Sundar Pichai [announced on Wednesday](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/next-chapter-ai-momentum/). Hassabis will continue to lead Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs, which aims to use AI to develop drugs. Koray Kavukcuoglu, formerly DeepMind's CTO, is stepping up to become Google's SVP of DeepMind and will report to Pichai. Kavukcuoglu will remain Google's chief AI architect as well.
